name: git-open-pr
description: Open a git-factory pull request, attributed to the automation bot. A single forge/run wrapper that authenticates with the run's own per-repo git: credential (least privilege -- no standing bot credential) and sets git-factory's createPull author override so the PR shows the bot, not the triggering user. Inputs: namespace, repo, title_b64, body_b64 (base64 so arbitrary text survives the shell), source_ref (the branch), target_ref (base, default dev), author_id (the bot user id, allowlisted server-side). Output: pr_number.

inputs.name: author_id
inputs.description: automation bot user id for the PR author override

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; mkdir -p /tmp/.openpr; GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); [ -n "$TOK" ] || { echo 'no run token in GIT_URL'; exit 1; }; printf '%s' '${inputs.title_b64}' | base64 -d > /tmp/.openpr/title.txt; printf '%s' '${inputs.body_b64}' | base64 -d > /tmp/.openpr/body.txt; RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 -X POST "$GF/repos/by-path" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"namespace\":\"${inputs.namespace}\",\"name\":\"${inputs.repo}\"}" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/'); [ -n "$RID" ] || { echo 'resolve repo failed'; exit 1; }; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/.openpr/mkbody.go; go run /tmp/.openpr/mkbody.go /tmp/.openpr/title.txt /tmp/.openpr/body.txt '${inputs.source_ref}' '${inputs.target_ref}' '${inputs.author_id}' /tmp/.openpr/pr.json; CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/.openpr/resp.json --max-time 60 --retry 3 --retry-all-errors -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/.openpr/pr.json); cat /tmp/.openpr/resp.json; echo; case "$CODE" in 2*) ;; *) echo "create PR failed: $CODE"; exit 1;; esac; PR_NUMBER=$(sed -E 's/.*"number":([0-9]+).*/\1/' /tmp/.openpr/resp.json); AUTHOR=$(sed -E 's/.*"author":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' /tmp/.openpr/resp.json); export PR_NUMBER; echo "opened PR #$PR_NUMBER author=$AUTHOR"; echo "PR_NUMBER=$PR_NUMBER"
